description: Watcher demo on Monad testnet (docs/adr/0006): DemoVaultFactory at its CREATE2 address announces new vaults; Deposit, Upgraded and BeaconUpgraded only re-check vaults the watcher already knows, so other testnet contracts do not become candidates. A subscription to a demo vault re-checks it every --subscribed-minutes, which is how switching its bug shows up.

sources.name: Specfirst DemoVaultFactory
sources.event: event VaultDeployed(address indexed vault, address indexed asset)

sources.name: ERC-4626 Deposit
sources.event: event Deposit(address indexed sender, address indexed owner, uint256 assets, uint256 shares)
